name: Rock Ur Bones
note: Erbil club co-founded by Rekan Rasool. One of the first public hiking collectives in the KRG. Friday and holiday outings, posted in local groups.
how: Ask in Erbil outdoor circles or the public Facebook community. No reliable public booking desk.

name: Kurdistan Outdoors
note: Friday hikes from Slemani and Erbil since about 2013. Arazu Hassan Mohammed is widely described as Iraq’s first public female hiking guide. Also books ZMT stages.
how: kurdistanoutdoor.com and Instagram @kurdistan_outdoor. Phone listed publicly +964 770 059 6661.

name: Peramagron Mountain Climbers
note: Slemani club named for the Piramagrun massif. Harder mountain days, not picnic walks.
how: Local club; ask through Slemani hiking circles.

name: Kurdistan Mountaineering and Climbing Federation
note: Coordinates clubs and mountain activity in Erbil Governorate. Not a consumer tour desk.
how: Federation / club channel, not an OTA.

name: Untamed Borders
note: Runs a multi-day Zagros Mountain Trail trek through rural communities, finishing toward Halgurd.
how: Booked as a packaged expedition, not a Friday walk.

name: Young Pioneer Tours
note: Seasonal group tours that include Iraqi Kurdistan. More city-and-road than peak-bagging.
how: International tour calendar.

name: Rocky Road Travel
note: Small-group Kurdistan tours, typically spring and October.
how: Tour dates on their site.

name: Choman / Halgurd local guides
note: Independent mountain guides based around Choman. Salar Chomany is a publicly named Halgurd guide. Approaches can be mined — go with someone who walked the line this season.
how: Arrange in Choman or through an Erbil club. Do not freelance the peak.

name: Soran and Shaqlawa hiking collectives
note: Town-level Friday groups documented in recent mountain-recreation research. They organise local peaks more than commercial packages.
how: Local WhatsApp / Facebook lists. No public cart.

name: Duhok mountain clubs
note: Public reporting places active clubs in Duhok as well as Erbil and Slemani.
how: Ask at Duhok outdoor shops or through KMCF-adjacent groups.

name: VIKurdistan / Omar Chomani
note: The Choman Halgurd base-camp desk. Books the official ZMT finish and summit days.
how: visitiraqikurdistan.com and Instagram @vikurdistan.

name: Gerrok Tourism
note: Erbil operator closely tied to the Zagros Mountain Trail launch.
how: Instagram @gerrok.tourism. Phone listed on the ZMT provider page.

name: Lutka Mountaineering Group
note: Slemani peak-bagging club. Visible on recent Halgurd mass-ascent coverage.
how: Instagram @lutka_mountaineering_group.

name: Zagros Mountain Trail
note: The 215 km community trail, Shush toward Halgurd. Village guides and homestays are listed on the official site.
how: zagrosmountaintrail.org — book stages through listed providers, not a cart.

name: Kurdistan Trails for Development
note: The local body Abraham Path names as independently managing the Zagros Mountain Trail.
how: Through the ZMT site and listed village providers, not a consumer cart.

name: Abraham Path Initiative
note: Supported creation of the 215 km trail. Not a day-to-day guiding company.
how: abrahampath.org — partner, not a booking desk.

name: Visit Kurdistan
note: KRG tourism board. Destination marketer and e-visa, not a mountain club.
how: visitkurdistan.krd and visit.gov.krd for the visa.

name: Iraqi Kurdistan Guide
note: Haval Qaraman. Licensed private guide since 2010. Hiking is one product among cultural days.
how: iraqikurdistanguide.com

name: Kurdistan and Iraq Tours
note: Sardar’s small desk. Documented taking foreign walkers on ZMT stages.
how: iraq-and-kurdistan-tours.com

name: Halabja Guide
note: Local listings for Hawraman and Qaradagh walks, including Kunejnoka and Mala Hasan.
how: halabja.guide — listings, then a local fixer.

name: Sulaymaniyah Mountaineering Group
note: Kurdish-language Slemani club, distinct from Peramagron. Friday peak days, not a tourist cart.
how: Facebook club page. Ask in Slemani outdoor circles.

name: Nawdaran Mountaineering Group
note: Named alongside KMCF and Peramagron in 2019 reporting. Current calendar is unclear.
how: Club channel only. Do not treat as a booking desk.
